scripts.dev: pnpm db:start && node scripts/dev-setup.ts && wrangler dev --port 8790
scripts.db:keys: cd ../.. && (test -f supabase/signing_keys.json || (echo '[]' > supabase/signing_keys.json && supabase gen signing-key --algorithm ES256 --append))
scripts.db:start: pnpm db:keys && PATH="$PATH:/Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin" supabase start --workdir ../.. > /dev/null && echo 'local Supabase is up'
